title: Armstands
description:
armorstands have arms with this command:

/function showarms:armorstands 

and you need to repete this command when you need armorstands arms!
body:
Minecraft has armorstands right ? But one thing...Armorstands...They have no arms!!!! Why bedrock players have this feature and we not ? But today is change (the change will be add if you download this datapack xd)...
**THIS DATAPACK ADDS:**
-Armorstands with arms 
But Warning ! only if you use folowing command:

"```/function showarms:armorstands```"

But wait ! This mod is still in early early alpha. This means when you use this command it rotate all of them in one way.
